entities.summary: Francis Herbert Dufty II, who was also known as Frank Dufty, was an English-born, Australian photographer, known for his photographs of Fiji. Dufty's contribution to Fiji was of primary importance in the 1870s, and he was one of Fiji's most significant, early photographers.
